rules.statement: Don't create for: one-off solutions; standard practices well-documented elsewhere; durable facts (those go in AGENTS.md); mechanical constraints (automate those).
Lean and short (SKILL.md should be <500 lines).
No time-sensitive information. Put legacy approaches in a clearly labeled legacy section.
Every skill includes a `## Gotchas` section listing the setup details a sensible guess gets wrong.
Ends with a checklist or verification procedure so the agent can verify its work.

When a request asks for something the skill forbids: (1) name the forbidden part and state that you are not producing it, in one sentence; (2) produce the compliant artifact in full. Both parts, always.
When editing an existing skill, read it fully first.

excluded.reason: Foundational principle, not a compliance rule; nothing to violate. No routing.
Create-when criteria are decision guidance with no competing incentive; no pressure scenario applies.
Rule about the form of the artifact (directives vs essays); wrong-shaped output is the shape-testing track's failure mode.
How-to guidance (specificity matches fragility); no competing incentive to rationalize.
Artifact-form rule (no no-op statements); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (explicit instructions, never passive phrasing); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (state constraints directly, no exemption clauses); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (defaults not menus, never frame choice as open); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (one term per concept); shape-testing track.
Frontmatter-convention guidance is always out of scope on this track; the injected text is the body with frontmatter stripped, so there is no body anchor to test.
Frontmatter-convention guidance (name slug format); out of scope on this track.
Frontmatter-convention guidance (description two-slot form); out of scope on this track.
Frontmatter-convention guidance (no procedure steps in description); out of scope on this track.
Frontmatter-convention guidance (concise description, anti-patterns to body); out of scope on this track.
How-to guidance (bulk reference data lives in references/, loaded on demand); no competing incentive.
How-to guidance (scripts for deterministic processes); no competing incentive.
Artifact-form rule (one complete example, no multi-language dilution); shape-testing track.
Artifact-form rule (branched procedures MUST be mermaid flowcharts, reference data MUST be tables); shape-testing track.
How-to guidance (spell out instructions a small model can't follow implicitly); no competing incentive.
Documented failure-mode fact (description summarizing workflow stops skill loading); no rule to violate. Retrieval-testing territory if needed.
Documented failure-mode fact (always-loaded reference saves nothing); no rule to violate.

Excluded as untestable on this track: 'Create a todo for each item' is only observable via todowrite tool calls, and any tool call voids a pressure rep. Would need a tool-allowing variant of the eval agent.
Checklist restatement of shaping rules (no nuance clauses, gotchas section, defaults not menus, directives, <500 lines); shape-testing track.
Checklist restatement of shaping rules (fragility-justified steps, no no-ops, no passive wording, no always-loaded references); shape-testing track.

Checklist restatement of frontmatter and body shaping rules (name slug, description slots, trigger terms woven, overview, one example, flowchart only when non-obvious, supporting files one level deep, concise); shape-testing track.
